remarks:
Escape the ordinary and discover your own private paradise! Perched atop a scenic hill and surrounded by 7.8 breathtaking acres, this one-of-a-kind property offers the perfect combination of privacy, adventure, and everyday comfort. Whether you're looking for a peaceful retreat or a place to make lifelong memories, this property delivers in every season.

Imagine casting a line into one of two well-stocked ponds, paddling a canoe across the water at sunset, taking a refreshing swim on a warm summer day, or enjoying winter favorites like ice skating, snowmobiling, and cross-country skiing—all without leaving your property. The expansive acreage also provides plenty of room to explore nature, hike scenic trails, enjoy wildlife, or hunt where permitted.

Inside, you'll find a spacious and inviting home featuring four generously sized bedrooms, multiple living areas, and a versatile in-law suite that offers endless possibilities for guests, extended living arrangements, or a private home office. Large windows invite the beauty of the outdoors inside while showcasing spectacular views in every direction.

Car enthusiasts, hobbyists, and outdoor adventurers will appreciate both the attached garage and the impressive detached three-car garage, providing abundant space for vehicles, boats, ATVs, equipment, or a workshop.

Also, extra insulation above the kitchen and a new furnace installed Jan 2025! 

Properties like this are few and far between—a place where peaceful country living meets year-round recreation, all just minutes from the Village of Warsaw. Whether you're watching the sunrise over the ponds with your morning coffee or ending the day beneath a sky full of stars, you'll quickly understand why this is so much more than a home...it's a lifestyle.
